text:
marina: Heads up — noticed duplicate NAT gateway egress charges on the March invoice for us-west1. Two separate line items with the same NAT resource id but different SKUs. Anyone else seeing this?
samira: yep saw a spike, roughly double what we expected for that region.
jin: can you paste the invoice lines or a snippet? makes triage easier.
marina: sure — pasted below (redacted)
```
LineItem: projects/123456789/regions/us-west1/nat/01A2B3C4D5  SKU: CLOUD_NAT_EGRESS  amount: 12,384.72 USD
LineItem: projects/123456789/regions/us-west1/nat/01A2B3C4D5  SKU: VPC_DNAT_EGRESS  amount: 11,980.33 USD
Credit: COMMITTED_USE_DISCOUNT  amount: -6,500.00 USD
```
samira: wait that second SKU is `VPC_DNAT_EGRESS` — we rolled on a DNAT config for internal egress last month but it should not double-charge.
alex.k: we enabled regional DNAT + Cloud NAT as a fallback during the autoscaler rollout. possible hairpin/double translation when nodes spun up?
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-03-43 uploaded to /billing/invoices/INV-2026-03-43.pdf (auto)
ops-oncall: quick checklist — (1) any cross-project NATs or Shared VPCs in play? (2) cross-region copies/snapshots? (3) confirm CU commitments applied after charges.
jin: I'm running a BigQuery join between VPC flow logs and NAT IPs to map translations -> VM id. will flag overlapping translations. ETA ~2h.
marina: opened GCP support case: case 1234567890. GCP initial response says "possible duplicate billing for concurrent NAT and DNAT translation paths" and they're escalating to billing eng.
samira: if GCP confirms, we should request a refund and also a corrected invoice. also add a billing alert for >8% deviation vs forecast for region-level egress.
alex.k: also check our infra: we likely left a legacy DNAT config in the shared VPC that got picked up by the rollout. if true, we should remove the redundant DNAT and document the config.
billing-bot: Created alert rule `billing.alerts/dnat-duplicate` threshold=8% over 7d. Notified: #finance, #eng-infra.
ops-oncall: action items: Jin (flow logs agg, 2h), Marina (follow up with GCP + escalate if no reply by EOD), Samira (draft refund/credit request), Alex.k (audit DNAT configs). I'll stitch into a postmortem if this becomes >$10k impact.
marina: all good — I'll post the GCP thread updates here. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
